Respondent  PRAYER: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o  praying to issue a writ of Certiorari to call for the entire record  with the impugned order of transfer passed by the 1st respondent in  R.No.3958/2024/S12/FSD, dated 19.07.2024, and quash the same.

For Petitioner : Mr.S.N.Ravichandran  For Respondent : Mr.K.Tippu Sultan,
 Government Advocate  ORDER

When the matter is taken up for hearing today, the learned Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the respondent would submit that after the impugned transfer order the petitioner voluntarily participated in the transfer https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
In the counseling, the petitioner opted Chinnamanallur in Theni District and in pursuance thereof, the petitioner joined there and now, he is continuing his duty.
Hence the issue raised in the present writ petition become infructuous.
2. Recording the submission made by the learned Government Advocate, the present writ petition is closed as infructuos.
Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
